d: Pandora and Polyphemus in the Alpha Centauri system from James Cameron’s Avatar.

canon-avatar:pandora.x: Lush, habitable exomoon of the gas giant Polyphemus in the Alpha Centauri A system; home of the Na’vi and source of unobtanium.

canon-avatar:polyphemus.x: Blue-and-violet gas giant orbiting in the habitable zone of Alpha Centauri A, orbited by fourteen moons including Pandora.

b.s: Exomoon Pandora orbiting the gas giant Polyphemus in the habitable zone of Alpha Centauri A, 4.37 light-years from Earth.
